name: brand-bar
description: The IOWA Bar — the visual starting point for all branded University of Iowa websites. Black bar (mobile) / gold bar (md+) containing the Logo tab and site name, with an optional second row for parent-site context.

options.name: narrow
options.description: Narrow version of the bar (50px min-height at md+, smaller logo and 1rem site name)

figma.notes: Style axis has a third value, Parent Title, for the WithParentSiteTitle slot composition (parent title in a narrow bar + site h1 in the second row, both baked visible); it maps to slots, not to this prop

options.name: healthcare
options.description: Health Care variant: taller bar (100px md+) with the IOWA Health Care lockup; passed through to the nested Logo

options.name: breakpoint
options.description: Responsive states. Mobile: black bar, gold site-name strip, auto height. MD+: gold bar, fixed heights. Page: larger logo/site-name.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Content beside the logo — typically <h1 class="site-name"> (or a parent-site-name div in the WithParentSiteTitle pattern)

figma.property: Show Site Name (boolean) + Site Name (text); parent-title pattern: Style=Parent Title variant (or Show Parent Title boolean + Parent Title text with Show Site Name OFF)

slots.name: second_row_content
slots.description: Second row below the bar (.iowa-bar__below), typically the site h1 when a parent site title occupies the top bar
slots.behavior: IMPORTANT: mere presence of this slot forces iowa-bar--narrow styling on the top bar (BrandBar.vue getClasses, line 34) — narrow=false cannot produce a tall bar when a second row exists

figma.property: Show Second Row (boolean) or the Style=Parent Title variant; below-site-name text binds to the Site Name property

geometryNotTokenized.parent-site-name: weight 300, font-size = site-name-font-size-narrow token (unified 2026-08-13), gold bg mobile → transparent md, padding 1.05rem 0 0 1.25rem, margin 0 0 -10px 0
geometryNotTokenized.narrow-tab-overhang-page: margin-bottom -6px on .logo--tab (page-container): narrow bar renders 50px (min-height token) / 64px (healthcare, emergent 70-6) with the tab hanging 6px below; Figma variant bars are height-fixed to match, not content-hugged; the tab must also PAINT ABOVE the below-row (production does) — Figma variants use itemReverseZIndex so the bar/tab stacks over the second row

a11y.notes: Site name should be the page h1 exactly once per page; logo carries its own accessible name (see contracts/logo.json)

behavior: Background is black below 980px and gold at 980px+ (brand-bar/background token per mode)
second_row_content presence forces narrow styling on the top bar regardless of the narrow prop
Heights at mobile are content-driven (token sentinel 0 = auto)
knownIssues: No Storybook story exercises healthcare=true for the bar (only Logo stories do); the Figma set includes Healthcare variants by construction
